description: Timeline of one transaction over 1-1440 minutes ending at "end" (default now): per minute (or per bucket above 60 minutes) requests, errors, requests over the response-time target, p95/median/average and time per layer, plus totals with a response-time histogram. Use it to see when a transaction got slow and in which layer. Take transactionId from transactions[].id of tideways_get_performance.

end.description: Last minute included, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm" in UTC. Defaults to now.

environment.description: Environment, e.g. "production" or "staging". Defaults to the configured environment, else production; criteria.environment (traces: each trace's environment) shows which was used. When results come back, an unknown name fails with an error.

minutes.description: Window length in minutes (max 1440 = 24h). Above 60 the timeline is downsampled to at most 60 points; bucketMinutes says how long each one is.

project.description: Tideways project as "project" or "organization/project". Defaults to the defaultProject that tideways_list_projects reports; call it for valid names.

service.description: Service, e.g. "web" or "worker". Defaults to the configured service, else the project's default service. A project can have several services; tideways_list_services lists them. When results come back, an unknown name fails with an error.

transactionId.description: Numeric transaction ID from transactions[].id of tideways_get_performance

name: tideways_get_transaction

bucketMinutes.description: Minutes covered by each timeline point; null when the timeline is too short to tell

criteria.description: What Tideways actually queried. Times are UTC "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm".

downstreamAverageMs.description: Average ms per request in each layer: sql, http, cache, al = autoloading, ct = compiling, io = file I/O, dns, runq = waiting for CPU, sleep, shell

responseTimeTargetExceeded.description: Requests slower than the project's response-time target

downstreamAverageMs.description: Average ms per request in each layer: sql, http, cache, al = autoloading, ct = compiling, io = file I/O, dns, runq = waiting for CPU, sleep, shell

markers.description: Response-time statistics marked on the histogram: 50%, Average, 90%, 95%, 99%, 99.9%, Max

histogram.description: Response-time distribution of the window; null when Tideways sends none

title: Get one transaction
